name: TRMNL client (4-grey 2-bit PNG)
description: Composition PNG fitted to the device's panel size, then quantised to 4 grey levels with the selected dither and written as a true 2-bit greyscale PNG (bit depth 2, colour type 0). For TRMNL firmware 1.6.0 and later on the TRMNL 7.5 inch (OG) class of panels, which decodes a 2-bit PNG and paints its 4 shades. Older TRMNL firmware cannot decode it and should stay on trmnl_png. Per-device picture quality (dither / contrast) lives on the device card.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
